title: The “game admin” can restore your item
scenario: After an in-game item disappears, someone claiming to be an admin offers to restore it. They ask you to trade them another item first “to verify the inventory system is working.”

answers.A: Check the game’s official list of moderators/admin procedures before interacting further.
answers.B: Send a low-value item first because a real admin should be able to return it instantly.
answers.C: Use the game’s official support process and do not transfer items to someone claiming to be staff.

explanation: Scammers use authority plus your frustration to make a “test trade” feel reasonable. Staff should not need your valuables to prove their tools.
proTip: Real support does not need a sacrifice item.
